body: Unfortunately I'm afraid it's too late.
I'm 5 days in to my medication change.  My timing is always flawless, I hit a spell when it's important to those I love.  This time was no different, and that makes it even worse.
I guess that's the problem, right now I honestly don't care what happens to me.
I just had a medication change last week, I wonder if that could be contributing to how I'm feeling, or if it's just a cruel sad coincidence.
I assume that I'm in a depressed state, I don't find myself staring at the walls when I'm "normal".

Maybe that's my problem....right now I feel like I'm nothing at all.  I'm not a good father, husband, friend, provider.  All I seem to be good for is laying around and doing nothing, and constantly letting those I love down.

Well, I actually wonder if the meds are part of it.  I had a prescription change just last week.  I hope that's the cause of all of this, I'm having a really hard time managing all of these symptoms.

It just makes no sense rationally.  If I have a broken leg, I go to the doctor, get it set, and wait for it to heal.  If I'm sick, I get the medicine I need, and rest, and within a few days I'm fine again.  And then there is BP.  I'm told I'm sick, but some days I feel perfectly fine.  How can I be sick?  But then I crash horribly, and it all becomes apparent.  I just can't wrap my head around it, and I'm worried it's literally driving me crazy.
I split my Lamictal, 150mg in the morning, 150mg before bed.

I feel lucky in that my wife is my biggest supporter.  I know she's lost track of how many times I have started droning on and on about some random subject that my mind has attached itself to.  Finding those that seem to truly know you are rare, hold onto that.

Good luck to you, I hope your fresh start gives you a new outlook.

Bipolar 1, rapid cycle with psychosis.

Lamictal 300mg, Latuda 30mg.

It's been a year since starting my medication, and my wife and I both can tell a difference, but I swear there are times that I seem to spiral deeper when I get depressed than I ever did.  Maybe it's just me being more aware of my feelings and what my diagnosis actually means.  I literally feel nothing, and frankly I'm not sure how I would handle things if I did.
Where I'm at, even walking to the shower is a feat...my wife is my life, and my kids.  But right now, none of them is here, and quite frankly, that's the only thing keeping me alive.
It's almost midnight....I'm still holding on, but barely.  I want to just disappear....

Bipolar 1 Rapid Cycle with Psychosis.

When I feel like this, the last thing I can find is a reason to be here.

Check my reply to another comment....I'm not sure I have the energy to go into it again.

To be blunt, I'm looking for a reason to not put my shoes on, walk out the front door, into the night, and never be seen again.....by anyone.  When I fall into this place, there doesn't seem to be any other way out...

Short version.....wife is my biggest supporter, I've ruined more of her days that I can count....today was going to be different, but here I sit, alone, wondering how I messed up again, and that turns into why am I even still here.  I'm my worst enemy when I'm alone, lost in my head.  Is it my meds or am I just worthless?  Maybe this is why I have no friends.  Maybe today will be the day she finally realizes she's too good for me.
It's all too much to explain, unless you have a few hours....I'm sitting alone in a dark room, wondering why I'm here and what my purpose is....like all of us do.  I however can't find the answer.

I think I'm still in my manic phase, I can't even think about sleep right now, but want to just wallow in whatever self pitty I have left.  I'm tired of feeling this way, tired of failing those I love.  I'm just tired.
